query:
SELECT 
  m.id,
  m.sponsorId,
  m.attendeeId,
  m.slotIndex,
  m.day,
  m.attendeeIndex,
  s.companyName as sponsorName
FROM meetings m
JOIN sponsors s ON m.sponsorId = s.id
WHERE m.isPublished = 1
ORDER BY m.day, m.slotIndex, m.sponsorId;
